name: @pipeworx/mcp-bitstamp

tools.name: ticker
tools.description: Fetch current Bitstamp ticker for a currency pair (e.g. btcusd): last price, bid, ask, 24h high/low/volume/vwap, and open.

tools.name: ticker_hour
tools.description: Fetch Bitstamp last-hour ticker stats for a currency pair (e.g. btcusd): last, bid, ask, high, low, volume, and vwap over the past 60 minutes.

tools.name: order_book
tools.description: Bitstamp crypto exchange (European; oldest active crypto exchange — est. 2011) order book for a crypto pair like "btcusd": bids + asks. Use for live depth-of-book on Bitstamp-listed pairs.

tools.name: transactions
tools.description: Fetch recent Bitstamp trades for a currency pair; optional time filter (minute, hour, day) sets the lookback window. Returns trade id, price, amount, type, and timestamp.

tools.name: eur_usd
tools.description: Bitstamp's own EUR↔USD conversion rate — the buy/sell prices Bitstamp applies when converting fiat balances on the exchange, quoted with the exchange's retail markup (the two legs can differ by several percent). Use when you need the rate a Bitstamp account actually transacts at. For the market FX rate — "EURUSD spot", "current euro to dollar rate", anything macro or reporting-grade — use ecb_exchange_rate, which publishes the official euro reference rate.

tools.name: trading_pairs
tools.description: List all Bitstamp trading pairs with metadata: base/counter currency, minimum order, symbol, trading enabled status, and URL symbol.

tools.name: ohlc
tools.description: Fetch OHLC candlestick data from Bitstamp for a currency pair; step sets candle duration in seconds, limit caps candle count, with optional Unix start/end range.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bitstamp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bitstamp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
